note: aihub protocol-v5 trial (Leo 2026-10-11): the five TCGA-LUAD KRAS cells (H-optimus-1 with CLAM, nnMIL, ABMIL and DTFD-MIL, plus TITAN), the cells of the v4 KRAS trial, rerun under v5 so the two trials compare cell for cell. They are split into three sets so that each of aihub's three RTX 6000 Ada GPUs runs one chain of run_discovery_chain.sh. Every baseline is trained on the RTX, the GPU type reproduction_policy.json declares for these sets. Each set is frozen and certified on its own; its results never enter the final experiment, which runs on fir only.
